label: Typed motion and mover fork selection
term: finite motion/mover interpretation and residual scope
definition: BroadMotion wraps the existing primitive broad MovedIn; PhysicalMotion additionally requires the supplied physical-respect classification. SomeMover contains a same-respect per-se witness; AnotherMover additionally requires distinctness; AnotherMoverAnyRespect wraps the existing some-respect distinct-mover reading. AccidentalMover contains only a witness of the separate primitive per-accidens relation. MotionMeaning and MoverMeaning select these typed interpretations by finite constructors. Selection coverage says that a constructor is selected; exclusivity says at most one is selected, not that extensions are disjoint. MotionCoverage separately covers moved instances by physical or residual respects. ResidualHasMover asserts mover coverage of the residual class.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Existing moved, per-se and per-accidens relations remain primitives with open applicability obligations. Physical means the supplied physical classification (place, quality or quantity in the existing Physics reading); residual marks the explicitly supplied remaining class for this route. Examples: a physical heating and a stipulated nonphysical intellectual reduction; the latter is a framework example, not an empirical proof. Inertial state is not automatically reduction. A singleton self-link tests distinctness, not animal part structure. No asymmetry, transitivity, irreflexivity or well-foundedness is imposed. AccidentalHasPerSeMover is an open conversion premise, not a definition of accidental moving. Coverage and exclusivity are separately explicit; only coverage is required for the weakest root theorem.
